description: This file defines the ContactsService class which implements contact management functionalities such as searching and adding contacts using the iOS Contacts framework. It includes methods for authorization, contact lookup, normalization, and payload creation.

classes.name: ContactsService
classes.description: A service class for managing contacts, including searching and adding contacts, with internal methods for authorization and contact matching.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches contacts based on parameters, returning a payload of contacts.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new contact or returns an existing one if matching contact is found.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and manages contact store authorization status.

methods.name: normalizeStrings
methods.description: Normalizes an array of strings, optionally lowercasing them.

methods.name: findExistingContact
methods.description: Finds an existing contact matching given phone numbers or emails.

methods.name: matchContacts
methods.description: Matches contacts based on normalized phone numbers and emails.

methods.name: normalizePhone
methods.description: Normalizes a phone number string by extracting digits.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Creates a payload object from a CNContact.
